scope: Positive extension iff finite stochastic locality or an actual setting-independent probability-integral model with measurable normalized responses; positive normalized linear averaging; classical CHSH, signed and uncertainty-adjusted bounds; complex Hilbert-space Tsirelson operator and pure/finite-mixture state bounds; exact two-qubit Born-table saturation; arbitrary finite-dimensional density spectral and binary-POVM conversions, real positive normalized Born tables, no-signalling marginals, exact CHSH score identity and local tensor lifts; finite Hermitian spectral trace-norm measurement contraction, weighted TV, local-comparison repair and state-distance witnesses; actual finite separable density mixtures and their positive extensions, partial-trace densities, product-marginal idempotence, and the full separable-infimum to product-residual bound for arbitrary finite local POVMs and its CHSH specialization; conditional matrix remainder and oriented CHSH dynamics with finite exit windows; finite scalar observer minimax and evidence-preserving recursion. Attained weighted Bell repair LP duality and normalized witness bounds, explicit slack-variable optimality, attained signed-extension negative-mass duality and vertex-spread witnesses; finite variable elimination and linear-image polyhedrality; intrinsic Bell tangent cones, exact short-ray repair and explicit quadratic trajectory bounds. Infinite-dimensional trace-class conversions and Mermin cohomology results are not claimed by this census. Real-parameter CHSH and eight-context Mermin negative-mass optima against all real signed extensions; contextual fraction as local-subdistribution packing, exact family values, explicit CF versus 2N counterexample and reversed ranking, and the constructive finite-context bound CF <= (m-1)N. Quantum CHSH-line caps from Hilbert-space bounds; explicit GHZ state, local POVMs, Born realization, unitary rotation block identities, exact first-interval exit and score/TV uncertainty-delayed windows. Full nine-context 3x3 two-qubit quantum counterexample to CF <= 2N, with an exact factor-four line and necessary universal coefficient at least four. Full rational 5x5 quantum counterexample to CF <= 4N with exact real optima; arbitrary-size parity-cycle optimization and quantum-cosine unboundedness; continuous complete-grid CHSH lower bounds and a 160/17 tail cap. The asymptotic coefficient is formalized as a quantified tail theorem. Cycle path reconstruction, global-sign propagation, two-fold packing equality and signed-budget equivalence are formalized. Constructive local Gram models, normalized complete signed extensions, vector normalization, exact finite ramp sums, restriction monotonicity and quantified unbounded comparison under explicit scalar envelope premises are proved. The cyclic profile, arbitrary finite real Clifford representation, maximally entangled density, local POVMs and every Born cell are constructed. The actual complete Bell family has an attained strictly positive signed optimum, the ratio bound and quantified quantum unboundedness with no supplied envelope or quantum-realization premise. Selected Archimedean finite shadow cutoffs and failure of a finite ratio endpoint are proved; no physical continuum or general matrix exponential/ODE claim is made.
